title: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in SaveBackupText() in backtext.c that allows attackers to corrupt stack memory by supplying long text…
desc: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in SaveBackupText() in backtext.c that allows attackers to corrupt stack memory by supplying long text fields. Attackers can craft a backup with long calendar or note fields that, when converted with gammu convertbackup, writes hex digits past the 10,000-byte stack buffer.

title: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in ReadWAPSettingsEntry() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted backup files with excess WAP or MMS…
desc: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in ReadWAPSettingsEntry() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted backup files with excess WAP or MMS settings entries. Attackers can supply a backup with more than four TitleNN keys in a [WAPSettings] or [MMSSettings] section, loaded via convertbackup, restore, or GSM_ReadBackupFile, causing crashes or potential code execution.

title: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ALCATEL_EncodeString() that allows attackers to overwrite stack memory via oversized encoded phonebook…
desc: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ALCATEL_EncodeString() that allows attackers to overwrite stack memory via oversized encoded phonebook text. Attackers can supply a crafted backup restored with gammu restore or addnew to an attached Alcatel phone, using GSM extension characters to crash Gammu or potentially execute code.

title: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in LoadBackup() that allows attackers to corrupt memory by supplying an overlong MD5 value in a crafted backup file.
desc: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in LoadBackup() that allows attackers to corrupt memory by supplying an overlong MD5 value in a crafted backup file. Attackers can overwrite adjacent phonebook and calendar entry pointers via strcpy() into MD5Original when files are loaded with convertbackup or restore, causing crashes or potential code execution.

title: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ReadBackupTextLen() that allows attackers to overwrite stack memory via crafted backup files.
desc: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ReadBackupTextLen() that allows attackers to overwrite stack memory via crafted backup files. Attackers can supply overlong quoted text values decoded into a 10,000-byte stack array during convertbackup, restore, or GSM_ReadBackupFile calls, causing crashes or potential code execution.

title: edbrowse through 3.8.19 contains an integer overflow in stringAndBytes() that allows malicious servers to write past a heap buffer by sending response bodies larger than 2 GB.
desc: edbrowse through 3.8.19 contains an integer overflow in stringAndBytes() that allows malicious servers to write past a heap buffer by sending response bodies larger than 2 GB. When a user browses to an attacker-controlled HTTP, FTP, or gopher server, the oversized body skips reallocation and corrupts the heap, causing crashes or potentially code execution.

title: libgphoto2 through 2.5.34 contains a stack buffer overflow in sierra_get_string_register() that lets a malicious sierra-protocol camera or USB device overwrite stack memory.
desc: libgphoto2 through 2.5.34 contains a stack buffer overflow in sierra_get_string_register() that lets a malicious sierra-protocol camera or USB device overwrite stack memory. When files are listed, the device can answer the file-name register with an oversized packet, writing up to 32 KB past small stack buffers to cause crashes or possible code execution.

title: POSTAL 2 before build 26810491 contains a sandbox escape vulnerability that allows malicious Steam Workshop mods to execute code by calling ConsoleCommand with a start file URI.
desc: POSTAL 2 before build 26810491 contains a sandbox escape vulnerability that allows malicious Steam Workshop mods to execute code by calling ConsoleCommand with a start file URI. Attackers can ship a batch file in a mod at the predictable workshop install path and launch it via ShellExecuteW, executing commands as the player on Windows.

title: Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg before 3.2.12 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the Posts Grid block and Atomic Wind query loop that…
desc: Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg before 3.2.12 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the Posts Grid block and Atomic Wind query loop that allows Contributor-level attackers to read non-public post type entries. Attackers can set the postTypes or queryPostType block attributes to types like flamingo_inbound or shop_coupon to expose titles and text, while the Atomic Wind custom_field path also leaks protected post meta.

title: Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg before 3.2.12 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows Contributor-level attackers to make the…
desc: Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg before 3.2.12 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows Contributor-level attackers to make the server contact arbitrary hosts via crafted Mailchimp API keys. Attackers can POST to the otter/v1/form/editor REST route with an apiKey whose data-center segment embeds a host, following redirects to internal services and reading partial responses.

title: bgpq4 before 1.17 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in expander.c that allows malicious IRR servers to corrupt heap memory by sending crafted A<len> replies.
desc: bgpq4 before 1.17 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in expander.c that allows malicious IRR servers to corrupt heap memory by sending crafted A<len> replies. Attackers controlling the IRR server or tampering with the plaintext TCP connection can announce a ULONG_MAX or -1 length, wrapping the allocation to one byte and crashing bgpq4.

title: SimGear through 2024.1.7 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in sgSimpleBuffer::resize() where an unsigned 32-bit wraparound in the size-doubling loop leaves the size at zero.
desc: SimGear through 2024.1.7 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in sgSimpleBuffer::resize() where an unsigned 32-bit wraparound in the size-doubling loop leaves the size at zero. Attackers can supply a crafted .btg scenery file with an oversized byte count exceeding 2^31 to hang the loading process in FlightGear.

title: FeatBit before 6.1.3 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated members of one organization to read other organizations' segments by supplying…
desc: FeatBit before 6.1.3 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated members of one organization to read other organizations' segments by supplying foreign segment identifiers. Attackers can query the SegmentController segment, by-ids, and flag-references endpoints with their own envId to retrieve end-user keys, targeting rules, and referencing feature flag keys.

title: picomatch through 4.0.7 contains a glob filter bypass vulnerability because globstar (**) patterns are compiled without the dotAll flag and fail to match line terminators.
desc: picomatch through 4.0.7 contains a glob filter bypass vulnerability because globstar (**) patterns are compiled without the dotAll flag and fail to match line terminators. Attackers who control file, object key or archive entry names containing newline characters can evade ** deny patterns, causing excluded resources to be included and exposed.

title: ClassroomIO through 1.0.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated course members to access other tenants' newsfeed posts by supplying…
desc: ClassroomIO through 1.0.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated course members to access other tenants' newsfeed posts by supplying a foreign feedId under their own courseId. Attackers can read, react to, and comment on cross-organization posts, while team members or org admins can also overwrite content, pin flags, and delete them.

title: Kestra 1.3.24 before 1.3.41 contains an insufficient credential expiration vulnerability that allows holders of a revoked administrator password to keep authenticating on peer…
desc: Kestra 1.3.24 before 1.3.41 contains an insufficient credential expiration vulnerability that allows holders of a revoked administrator password to keep authenticating on peer webserver nodes through BasicAuthService's process-local verified-token cache. Attackers whose token remains cached on a peer node can call POST /api/v1/{tenant}/basicAuth to overwrite the shared administrator credentials and lock out the legitimate administrator.

title: Kestra 1.3.24 before 2.0.0 contains a timing side-channel vulnerability in BasicAuthService.isAuthenticated() that allows unauthenticated attackers to enumerate the administrator…
desc: Kestra 1.3.24 before 2.0.0 contains a timing side-channel vulnerability in BasicAuthService.isAuthenticated() that allows unauthenticated attackers to enumerate the administrator username. Attackers can send Basic-auth requests with candidate usernames to protected API endpoints and detect slower bcrypt checks to identify the valid account for password guessing.

title: Kestra before 1.3.36 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute JavaScript by injecting HTML into the executions…
desc: Kestra before 1.3.36 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute JavaScript by injecting HTML into the executions page sort parameter. Attackers can lure logged-in users to a crafted link whose invalid sort value is rendered unsanitized in an error toast, stealing the non-HttpOnly BASIC_AUTH credential cookie to take over the instance.

title: HyperSpy from 1.4.0 before 2.6.0 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute arbitrary Python code by supplying crafted stored-model data…
desc: HyperSpy from 1.4.0 before 2.6.0 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute arbitrary Python code by supplying crafted stored-model data in .hspy or .zspy files. Attackers can embed a malicious pickle payload in a component's _class_dump or a 'fn'-flagged _whitelist entry, which cloudpickle.loads() (dill in 1.x) runs when the victim restores the model.

title: HyperSpy from 1.2.0 before 2.6.0 contains a code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run Python code by embedding malicious expression strings evaluated with…
desc: HyperSpy from 1.2.0 before 2.6.0 contains a code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run Python code by embedding malicious expression strings evaluated with sympy.sympify(). Attackers can craft .hspy or .zspy files with malicious axis, Expression component, or twin function expressions that execute when victims call hs.load() or restore models.

title: A security vulnerability has been detected in TRENDnet TEW-751DR and TEW-733GR 1.03B01.
desc: A security vulnerability has been detected in TRENDnet TEW-751DR and TEW-733GR 1.03B01. Affected is the function soapcgi_main of the file /soap.cgi of the component UPnP Igd Control Endpoint. Such manipulation of the argument service leads to os command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

title: A weakness has been identified in TRENDnet TEW-751DR 1.03B01.
desc: A weakness has been identified in TRENDnet TEW-751DR 1.03B01. This impacts the function FUN_0040ed90 of the file wfadev.cgi of the component UPnP/WFA. This manipulation of the argument SOAPAction causes stack-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. A high degree of complexity is needed for the attack. The exploitability is said to be difficult. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

title: Themify Base WordPress theme through 1.2.4 does not perform capability checks on its option save and read AJAX actions, which are protected only by a generic nonce that other…
desc: Themify Base WordPress theme through 1.2.4 does not perform capability checks on its option save and read AJAX actions, which are protected only by a generic nonce that other  commonly expose on the front end, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to update arbitrary blog options such as the default role and open registration, and gain administrator access when such a  is active.

title: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not properly check authorization before allowing a user to store popup preview data against arbitrary posts, nor restrict…
desc: The Popup Builder  WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not properly check authorization before allowing a user to store popup preview data against arbitrary posts, nor restrict who can read that content back on public requests, allowing users granted access to the Popup Builder  WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 to disclose the private and draft content of posts they do not own to unauthenticated visitors.

title: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not validate a user-supplied URL before requesting it server-side and storing the fetched response so that it can be read…
desc: The Popup Builder  WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not validate a user-supplied URL before requesting it server-side and storing the fetched response so that it can be read back, allowing users with Administrator privileges to perform Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attacks and read the responses of internal services.

title: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not check the publish status or the visitor's capabilities before rendering a popup requested by its ID in the URL, allowing…
desc: The Popup Builder  WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not check the publish status or the visitor's capabilities before rendering a popup requested by its ID in the URL, allowing unauthenticated users to read the content and configuration of popups that are still drafts or are marked private.

title: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not properly sanitize and escape a popup shortcode attribute before it is reflected into a page and evaluated client-side…
desc: The Popup Builder  WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not properly sanitize and escape a popup shortcode attribute before it is reflected into a page and evaluated client-side, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to inject arbitrary JavaScript that executes in the session of any higher-privileged user, such as an administrator, who views the affected content.

title: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not sanitise or escape a custom styling value before storing it and printing it back into the pages a popup loads on…
desc: The Popup Builder  WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not sanitise or escape a custom styling value before storing it and printing it back into the pages a popup loads on, allowing users who are allowed to manage popups (an ability that can be delegated to lower-privileged roles) to inject JavaScript that executes in the browser of every visitor, including logged-in administrators.

title: HCL Verse for Android included a decryption code for compatibility with locally stored values and attachment files created by older application versions (no longer used for data…
desc: HCL Verse for Android included a decryption code for compatibility with locally stored values and attachment files created by older application versions (no longer used for data stored by newer versions). HCL Verse for Android version 14.5.16 (November 2026) removed the legacy decryption code.

title: Improper Content Security Policy (CSP) configuration in the BigFix MCM WebUI allowed the data: URI scheme as a source in the img-src directive of the CSP header.
desc: Improper Content Security Policy (CSP) configuration in the BigFix MCM WebUI allowed the data: URI scheme as a source in the img-src directive of the CSP header. This potentially weakens the application's defense-in-depth security mechanism.
